name: Brassophone
author: nvmsocool
description: Brassophone by nvmsocool starts each note as a soft sine and opens it into a brassy tone as the OP-1's envelope rises. The pitch follows the envelope too, up to about a quarter tone sharp at its peak, so notes lean in the way a horn player's do. Hold a note: once the envelope settles at sustain, vibrato fades in. Shape it on the normal T2 envelope page; a slow attack makes the swell easy to hear.
credits: From op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
